name: web-burgundy-luxury-catering-hero-with-script-title
title: Burgundy hero with oyster and silver dish photograph under giant flourished script
whatItIs: A deep burgundy still life with a silver tazza holding a whipped cream peak, silver plates, an oyster shell and scattered pearls. A huge white calligraphic script 'The Artelle' sweeps across it, with a small caps tagline at the left.
whatItMeans: Opulent and theatrical; script over glossy metal suggests fine dining and heirloom craft.
techniques: Lay a very large script across a still life so it weaves through the objects.
Use a monochrome burgundy set with silver highlights.
Keep the tagline small and uppercase.

vocabulary.definition: A hero image made of arranged objects.
A shallow footed dish used for serving.
A scene styled in one colour family.
